description: relay_client.rs:60 and mta_sts_fetcher.rs test_client(): both build reqwest clients with redirect::Policy::none(). RFC 8461 §3.3 explicitly forbids redirect following during the policy fetch — an attacker who controls an intermediate server could redirect to a server they control. This is correct and should be preserved. The comment in mta_sts_fetcher.rs explains the security rationale clearly.
title: Redirect-following disabled in HTTP client prevents policy MITM
